marta.s: Heads up — noticed SCIM deprovision audit events are absent for a subset of EU tenants starting ~2024-05-17 09:12 UTC. Correlates with yesterday's RBAC change that tightened key access. Can we triage?

ben.d: Confirmed. Audit ingestion shows gap for events of type `user_deactivated` and `group_remove`. Raw SCIM webhooks hit our queue, but logs after KMS encryption step are empty.

samir.r: @marta.s do we have any KMS errors in the logs? I pulled the last 50 KMS client traces, saw a couple of 403s for alias lookup around the change window.

marta.s: Pasting minimal trace:

```
2024-05-17T09:11:59Z svc-scim-processor INFO incoming webhook id=xxx
2024-05-17T09:12:01Z svc-scim-processor ERROR encrypt_kms: AccessDeniedException alias/redwood-eu-tenant-enc
2024-05-17T09:12:01Z svc-scim-processor WARN dropping payload after encrypt step id=xxx
```

elaine: That 403 aligns w/ the RBAC change for `kms:Encrypt` scoped to service-account roles. I think the new policy omitted the alias ARN pattern for older tenants.

marta.s: Also saw some redaction in the audit stream — when we fail encryption we write a redacted placeholder instead of the event. That explains the missing audit rows, not total loss, but still unacceptable for compliance.

oncall: security-bot created incident INC-2024-054 with sev=2. Notifying compliance channel and PagerDuty.

ben.d: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert RBAC tweak for KMS to include alias pattern, 2) fallback to non-encrypted audit pipeline (write to secure S3) while we backfill, 3) run backfill job for affected tenant window. Which should we do first?

samir.r: We must avoid long-term plaintext writes. My suggestion: restore minimal `kms:Encrypt` alias permissions for the processor role (fastest), enable backfill, and keep the redact-on-fail behavior disabled so failures surface as errors but still capture raw payload to an encrypted backstop location.

elaine: I can authorize an emergency change to the KMS policy to re-add alias access for `svc-scim-processor` role. Will push with approval chain (security lead + infra).

marta.s: Before we flip anything, two asks: 1) confirm we're not reintroducing a privilege escalation vector (e.g., giving encrypt to a principal that can call decrypt on same key), 2) capture affected tenant list (we need scope for compliance).

ben.d: For #1 the service role already only has Encrypt/GenerateDataKey permission, Decrypt is in a separate key policy for the vault role. I will audit key policies to be safe. For #2 I parsed the queue: tenants with prefix eu-legacy- have webhook treaties in the time range. Quick list: eu-legacy-23, eu-legacy-87, eu-legacy-91 — ~320 events.

samir.r: Doing a quick policy diff now. The removed rule was a single line limiting alias ARN to `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/redwood-*`. Without it, the processor role can't resolve alias -> keyid, hence AccessDenied. Restoring that line should fix immediate failures.

elaine: I've queued an emergency policy revert. Will add approvers: @security-lead and @infra-lead. ETA 12 minutes.

security-bot: approval request created for KMS policy change. Link: https://internal/approvals/2345 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta.s: While the revert is pending: can we change the redact-on-fail to instead push the raw payload (encrypted with a fallback staging key) to s3? That way we don't lose data if the main KMS path is flaky.

ben.d: I can deploy a hotfix to switch redact->backup-s3 mode. It's a config flip plus an IAM role that uses `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/fallback-stage-key` which we already hold. Will coordinate with infra.

samir.r: Important vuln triage note — we saw a couple of webhook payloads containing Bearer tokens in a debug param. Those tokens are short-lived but could be sensitive. For the backfill we must scrub tokens or rotate them before handing to audit.

marta.s: Good catch. Add to action items: rotate exposed tokens, scrub sensitive fields in backfill, log scrubbing rules documented.

elaine: Approval granted by @security-lead. Applying policy revert now.

oncall: Policy change applied at 2024-05-17T09:24:30Z. KMS alias resolve OK on first retry.

ben.d: Confirmed. svc-scim-processor retries succeeded, subsequent encrypts returned 200 and audit rows resumed writing. Backfill job started (job id bkf-20240517-01).

marta.s: Running a small verification: backfill processed 312 events, scrubbed 14 tokens, uploaded to s3://redwood-sec-backfill/eu/2024-05-17/bkf-20240517-01.enc, checksums match.

samir.r: Follow-ups: (1) update CI policy lint to catch alias ARN regressions, (2) add KMS alias resolution alert if >1% encrypt errors in 5m, (3) update runbook to prefer fallback-stage-key pattern for backfills.

marta.s: I'll own the runbook edits and the compliance writeup. Ben, Samir — please add the CI/alert tasks to the security backlog and tag for Q2.

ben.d: Will create PRs.

elaine: Closing incident once compliance signs off on backfill proof. Good work y'all :thumbsup:

security-bot: INC-2024-054 status -> monitoring.
